serviceArea.statement: We serve Vancouver, Surrey, Richmond, Burnaby and Victoria, plus Vancouver Island and events anywhere in British Columbia — including destination events further afield. Travel arrangements can be made for locations across the province.

machine.name: Pure Love
machine.description: Our custom "Pure Love" machine is a showpiece in its own right — and its glow can be set to match your palette, from soft blush to romantic gold.

faq.question: What areas do you serve?
faq.answer: We serve Vancouver, Surrey, Richmond, Burnaby and Victoria, plus Vancouver Island and events anywhere in British Columbia — including destination events further afield. Travel arrangements can be made for locations across the province.

faq.question: How far in advance should I book?
faq.answer: Most couples book us 6 months to a year ahead of their wedding date. Popular dates fill up quickly, so reaching out early gives you the best chance of securing your preferred date.

faq.question: What’s included in each collection?
faq.answer: Every collection includes the machine, premium plush prizes, a professional booth attendant, delivery, setup, and breakdown. The Signature collection adds unlimited plush prizes and priority date booking; Bespoke is fully tailored to your event.

faq.question: Do you handle delivery and setup?
faq.answer: Yes — full delivery, setup, and breakdown are included with every collection. We typically arrive 1–2 hours before your event starts to get everything in place.
